documents.title: AGENTS.md
documents.text:
# AGENTS.md

The 40 Thieves ship MCP servers. Start from the manifest at https://the40thieves.dev/manifest.json.

- CodeCalc: a calculator for agents.
- Alexandria MCP: a library for agents.

documents.title: Alexandria MCP
documents.text:
# Alexandria MCP

A library server for agents: ingest sources, index them, and ask questions with citations.

Install with `claude mcp add alexandria -- uvx alexandria-mcp`.

documents.title: CodeCalc
documents.text:
# CodeCalc

A calculator, a code runner and a logic checker for AI agents: 51 MCP tools across 31 languages, sandboxed in Rust, no LLM in the loop.

## Install

`uvx 'codecalc[full]' setup --write`

## Guide

### Part 1

Section 1 of the CodeCalc guide explains how the calculator tool evaluates an expression inside the Rust sandbox, how the code runner picks one of the thirty-one language runtimes, and how the logic checker reports a contradiction without any LLM in the loop. Each call is bounded in time and memory, and the result carries the runtime name so an agent can cite it.
